key_points: CSX stock rose 1.91% on Oct 4 after Susquehanna cut its price target.
Stocktwits noted CSX, UNP, NVCR surged to 52‑week highs on the same day.
No fundamental news (earnings, guidance, M&A) was reported in the headlines.
Other railroad coverage focused on CN/NSC, not CSX.
Price move appears driven by short‑term momentum rather than thesis‑changing factors.
